description: A periodic maintenance fee may apply depending on the account variant and applicable terms.
conditions: Depends on account type and minimum balance requirements.

description: A fee may apply when ATM withdrawal limits or applicable free transaction limits are exceeded.
conditions: Applicable after the permitted free ATM transactions are exhausted.

description: A service fee may apply to certain NEFT transactions depending on the account type and transfer channel.
conditions: Depends on transaction amount and applicable banking terms.

description: A service fee may apply to eligible RTGS transactions.
conditions: Depends on transaction amount, channel, and applicable banking terms.

description: A service fee may apply to certain IMPS transactions.
conditions: Depends on transaction amount and applicable banking terms.

description: A replacement fee may apply when a debit card needs to be reissued.
conditions: May vary depending on card variant and reason for replacement.

description: A fee may be charged when a cheque is returned unpaid.
conditions: Applicable when a cheque is returned unpaid, subject to account terms.

description: A processing fee may be charged for evaluating and processing a loan application.
A prepayment charge may apply when a borrower repays an eligible loan before its scheduled maturity.
conditions: Depends on loan product, interest-rate type, and applicable terms.

description: International card transactions may incur foreign exchange conversion charges and other applicable fees.
conditions: Depends on card variant, transaction type, and applicable exchange-rate terms.
